acceptance: Red-first: the routing of cloud-builder starts at claude-cloud with no policy.json edit.
A guard test: the rendered prompt of cloud-builder holds no rule that forbids commit or push.
Red-first: a fallback from the cloud seat to a local seat is refused or gets a usable scope.
100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments; runtime-reference names the profile.
fix: Add a profile cloud-builder with cli claude-cloud first and the policy order as fallback, and a persona whose deliverable is one pull request. Keep the local build rules that still apply. A fallback to a local seat must get a writable scope that can hold the work, or refuse.
source: console 2026-11-04: launching through console-builder on claude-cloud needed a temporary policy.json rule. The wave preflight saw that uncommitted control-plane file and fell back to sequential, so wave 153 ran one serial cycle. The console-builder persona also says 'never commit or push', which contradicts the pull request that a cloud seat must deliver.
summary: Two defects of the cloud seat: selecting it edits a control-plane file, and its persona forbids its deliverable.
title: A cloud-builder profile and persona, so a cloud launch needs no policy edit and its persona asks for a pull request
